title: 寄居蟹换了新房子
subtitle: 长大了，就要换一个大一点的
character: wearing a pale yellow t-shirt and orange shorts, bare feet, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, colored pencil drawing, warm sandy palette with soft coral accents, visible pencil strokes and gentle cross-hatching, soft daylight
neg_extra: scary, pincers threatening, dark, realistic photo

pages.zh:
还是那片海滩。
今天我敢走近一点了。
我蹲下来找贝壳。
找一个会跑的。
pages.scene: A little boy crouching on wet sand close to the water's edge, looking down at the sand for shells, a small bucket beside him, bright open beach, calm sea behind.

pages.zh:
我捡到一个漂亮的贝壳。
咦——它在动！
它长出脚来，跑起来了。
pages.scene: Close up of a little boy's open palm holding a pretty spiral shell, small crab legs poking out of the shell opening, the boy's surprised face behind slightly out of focus.

pages.zh:
爸爸说：
「这不是贝壳。
这是寄居蟹。
它住在别人的空壳里。」
pages.scene: A father crouching beside a little boy on the sand, both looking closely at a hermit crab sitting in a spiral shell on the boy's palm, warm and gentle.

pages.zh:
寄居蟹自己没有硬壳。
它前面是硬的，
后面软软的、卷卷的。
所以它要找一个空壳，
钻进去，背着走。
走到哪儿，家到哪儿。
pages.scene: A clear friendly picture book diagram of a hermit crab half out of its shell on plain sand, showing hard front claws and a soft curled belly, gentle and cute, not scary, plenty of empty space around it.

pages.zh:
我把它放回沙子上。
它背着家，
慢慢走远了。
身后一串小脚印。
pages.scene: A hermit crab walking away across wet sand carrying its spiral shell tilted on its back, small tracks left behind it, low close viewpoint.

pages.zh:
可是它一直在长大。
壳不会跟着长大。
有一天，
屁股露出来了。
pages.scene: One hermit crab in a small spiral shell that is too small for it, its soft curled pink tail poking out of the back of the shell, looking surprised, no people in the picture

pages.zh:
于是它要搬家。
试一个——太小。
再试一个——太大。
再试一个——刚刚好。
pages.scene: A hermit crab beside three empty spiral shells of different sizes on the sand, reaching toward one to compare, busy and small, lots of sand around.

pages.zh:
它飞快地钻出来，
一下子钻进新壳。
这一秒，
屁股光着。
是它最紧张的时候。
pages.scene: One hermit crab halfway out of its small old shell, its soft curled pink tail clearly uncovered and bare, reaching its front legs into a big empty spiral shell right in front of it, no people in the picture

pages.zh:
有时候，
好几只寄居蟹排成一队。
大的换了新壳，
旧壳就留给小的。
一个传一个，谁都有房子。
pages.scene: Four hermit crabs of different sizes standing in a row on the sand from biggest to smallest, each in a spiral shell, one empty shell beside the biggest crab, no people in the picture

pages.zh:
我把捡到的空壳，
又放回沙滩上。
说不定有一只寄居蟹，
正在到处找房子呢。
pages.scene: A little boy crouching on the sand carefully placing an empty spiral shell back down on the beach, sea in the background, warm afternoon light.
